### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **172** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 48231b024ed7a9f0c9be73f34a5bf5f48c7a1d68` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8973d2523b6986b5efb6c5e4a6a6240b7dead709` — the merge of head `1a29fff73ae896337bf1a00f98f8e33e4ca77685` into base `48231b024ed7a9f0c9be73f34a5bf5f48c7a1d68`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8973d2523b6986b5efb6c5e4a6a6240b7dead709 && git checkout 8973d2523b6986b5efb6c5e4a6a6240b7dead709
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 48231b024ed7a9f0c9be73f34a5bf5f48c7a1d68 1a29fff73ae896337bf1a00f98f8e33e4ca77685 && git checkout -B drift-repro 48231b024ed7a9f0c9be73f34a5bf5f48c7a1d68 && git merge --no-ff 1a29fff73ae896337bf1a00f98f8e33e4ca77685

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 48231b024ed7a9f0c9be73f34a5bf5f48c7a1d68
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `14289976eda6a3c6b9778258bec2e1b1e8175435`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the PR diff against merge-base `989ae42d01` (all 15 files, 140 insertions, 6 deletions, one commit); `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` at head (`SpecifierHandlerSchema.confirmText` :97 and :103, `SpecifierSchema` :389, the new key :536-547, the `superRefine` :555, the `valueDomain` arm :575-581, the new arm :586-592); `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts` :306-344; `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (convention comment :2274-2288, `platformSettingsShape` :2269, the strict `keys` entry :2312-2324, `actions` aliases :2331, `TranslationDataSchema` :2365-2380 and the platform-only note :2241-2258); `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts` :1800-1847; `packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts` :541-543; `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` :5228-5260; `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts` :26-36; `auth.manifest.test.ts` :1-8 and :291-302; `service-settings/src/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.ts` and `index.ts` :28; `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` at head (:52-56, :82-90, :108-135, :150-164); `settings-service.ts` :1233-1250 and :2860-2870; `settings-service-plugin.ts` :296-302; `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/useSettingsLabel.ts` :12-14, :100, :151-157 and `SettingsField.tsx` :625; `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts` :1443-1453, `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts` :255; `packages/spec/{api-surface,declaration-map,json-schema.manifest}/system.json`, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `authorable-surface.base.json`, `llms.txt` (grep census); `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` :1-40 and :2180-2200; `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` :443 and :558; `scripts/check-i18n-walk-parity.mjs` :195-232; `.changeset/30202-keep-a-sign-in-method.md` :1-5; card #30418 body and 5 comments (triage 6656303889, ruling 6657805240, two claims, os-dev-report 6659112911); PR #30489 body, 2 comments, 0 reviews; check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Ruling bind (1), the key. `settings-manifest.zod.ts` :545-547 declares `confirmOffText: I18nLabelSchema.optional().describe("Confirm dialog text shown before a toggle's value changes to off (omit = no confirm)")`, the ruling's sentence with its initial capitalised, on `SpecifierSchema` (:389) beside `handler` (:534) and ahead of `childNamespace` (:550). It uses the same `I18nLabelSchema` import (:7) the handler's `confirmText` uses at :97 and :103, so a bare string and an inline locale map both parse, which the pins at :310-318 cover. The TSDoc at :536-544 names the translation address and the toggle-only rule. Nothing like `confirm: { when, text }` is added anywhere in the diff (bind (5)); the #30202 server floor is untouched (no `plugin-auth` file in the diff).
2. Ruling bind (2), toggle only. The arm at :586-592 sits inside the existing specifier `superRefine` (:555), directly after the `valueDomain` arm (:575-581) and before the `select/radio/multiselect` options arm (:593), as the order asks. Predicate `spec.confirmOffText !== undefined && spec.type !== 'toggle'` refuses every non-toggle type, input and layout alike; issue `code: custom`, `path: ['confirmOffText']`, message `Specifier of type '${spec.type}' has no off to confirm, so it must not declare a 'confirmOffText' (only a 'toggle' may).` names both the key and the type. One honest boundary, shared with the `valueDomain` arm it mirrors: `SettingsService.registerManifest` (:1233) takes a `SettingsManifest` without parsing it through `SettingsManifestSchema` (no `.parse` or `safeParse` of a manifest anywhere in `settings-service.ts`), so the refusal bites at the spec parse door and in each manifest's own test (`auth.manifest.test.ts` :296 parses), not at boot. That is the standing shape of every arm in this `superRefine`, not something this PR changes.
3. Ruling bind (3), the declaration. `auth.manifest.ts` :35 declares `confirmOffText: 'People who sign in with a password will need another way in.'` on the `email_password_enabled` toggle (:27-28), the #30299 sentence as a sentence. The translation path is the toggle's own: the platform bundle address `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText` sits beside `.label` in `en.ts` :175-178, `zh-CN.ts` :285-288, `ja-JP.ts` :138-141, `es-ES.ts` :138-141, the same `settings.<ns>.keys.<key>.*` convention the console's `useSettingsLabel` probes for `label`, `help` and `placeholder` (:151-153) and `resolveSettings*` reads on the server. The console probe for this leaf and any `resolveSettingsFieldConfirmOff` export are the `domain:ui` half (ruling (4)); the PR's acceptance note says so and the `Carried:` line names it. The four bundles carry the text; `SettingsField.tsx` :625 (`case 'toggle'`) is untouched, so nothing shows yet, as the body states.
4. The flagged deviation, `translation.zod.ts`. Necessary: the `keys` entry at :2312 is a `strictObject` (`strict-object.ts` :541-543 builds a `.strict()` closed object whose unknown-key refusal is terminal), so `{ label, confirmOffText }` was refused by `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` before this PR, and `settingsBuiltinTranslations` is typed `PlatformTranslationBundle` (`translations/index.ts` :28), so the four bundles would not have typechecked either. Correctly scoped: the leaf is added only to the platform face's `keys` entry (:2322-2323), the one address where a specifier's labels live; the `actions` entry already has its own `confirmText` (:2338) and is not touched; the per-app `TranslationDataSchema` (:2365-2380) refuses the whole `settings` group by name, pinned at `translation.test.ts` :1803-1830, so no app-authored door widens. Ripples: the generated `translation.mdx` row moved (the `{ … }` truncation at :344 and :512), `check:i18n-walk-parity` does not walk `settings` on the per-app face (it left that face on #15178, :200-209, and the ledger at :215-224 names only `messages` and `settingsCommon`), no `scripts/check-i18n-*` gate names `settings`, and `llms.txt` carries no `Specifier` or `confirmText` token at all (0 hits), so its claims are unmoved, as the body says. Locales: the `settings` group is carried by `service-settings` alone (no `settings` group in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales` or `platform-objects` translations; `email_password_enabled` appears in no other bundle), and that package ships four locales, not eleven; the coverage test holds zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES to full coverage of a declared `confirmOffText` (:85-88) and refuses undeclared copy in all four (:128-132, :159-164), while a runtime miss falls back to the manifest literal (`useSettingsLabel` :100 asks `i18n.exists` before translating and returns the fallback). Fall back, not refused, which is the repo's rule for served translations, and the shipped locales are held complete by the test rather than by a gate. One precision on the body's wording: nothing parses the bundle at boot (`settings-service-plugin.ts` :296-302 hands it to `i18n.loadTranslations` raw), so "the bundle the service ships would be refused" is true of the contract and of `tsc`, not of a running server. Judged accurate as a contract statement.
5. Ripples by generator. `authorable-surface/system.json` :1139 gains the one row `system/Specifier:confirmOffText` in sorted position (the spec build writes it; `check:authorable-surface` reported green); `authorable-surface.base.json` is the deletion anchor rewritten only by `--update-base` (`build-schemas.ts` :191-195) and correctly stays put. `settings-manifest.mdx` gains the row twice (:126 and :209, the two tables that print `Specifier`), and `translation.mdx` twice, in `gen:docs` shape. `api-surface/system.json`, `declaration-map/system.json`, `json-schema.manifest/system.json` and `llms.txt` list exports and schemas, not keys (0 `confirmText` hits in each at head), so they rightly do not move. `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` has no `settings-manifest` site and an arm on an existing `superRefine` adds none (`check:generated` green per the dev). No file in the diff is hand-edited generated output by reading.
6. Liveness. `packages/spec/liveness/README.md` roots the walk in `BUILTIN_METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS` and sets the denominator as registered kinds plus `listUnregisteredKindSchemaTypes()` (`check-liveness.mts` :1443-1453); `UNREGISTERED_KIND_SCHEMAS` (`metadata-type-schemas.ts` :255) holds `webhook`, `connector`, `analytics_cube` and kin, no settings manifest; `packages/spec/liveness/` has no `settings_manifest.json` and no `Specifier` row in any ledger. Not governed; the body says so, as the order's item 5 allows. `Spec property liveness` is green on the head.
7. Declarations. PR body and changeset both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` (arm read as `widening` by `readClause2Line`, `clause2-line.mjs` :443) and `Metadata-protocol: added` (`readMetadataProtocolLine` :558). The changeset grades `@objectstack/spec` minor, which is what `added` owes (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` :9-15, :2187-2188), and moves the `authorable-surface/` baseline, consistent with a declared kind; `Check Changeset` is green and the dev's local run read "no major". `@objectstack/service-settings` is also graded minor; the gate accepts it because the predicate is PR-scoped (:17-20), but the LEVEL axis says a minor is earned by a protocol change and by nothing else (:2191-2193), and this package's change is a manifest declaration plus bundle text, not protocol; the nearest precedent, `.changeset/30202-keep-a-sign-in-method.md` :1-4, graded the same package patch. A should-fix, not a gate failure.
8. Pins. `settings-manifest.test.ts` :306-344: acceptance on a toggle with the text kept (:309-312), an inline locale map (:314-317), absence parsing to `undefined` (:319-322), and refusal on four types, `text` and `select` (input) and `group` and `action_button` (layout), each with a control that the bare specifier parses, then exactly one `custom` issue at `['confirmOffText']` whose message contains the type and the key (:326-343). That exceeds the order's "one input type, one layout type". The ablation reported (arm to `if (false)`, 4 red of 78, restored blob equal to HEAD) matches by reading: nothing else in the file exercises the arm. `translation.test.ts` :1838-1846 pins the platform face accepting the leaf with `safeParse` success and the value read back. `auth.manifest.test.ts` :295-302 parses the shipped manifest, asserts the specifier is a `toggle` carrying the exact sentence, and that the en bundle carries the same string at its address. The coverage test's new paths (:85-88, :128-132) run on every shipped locale and are green only because all three translations exist. All real.
9. Body matches code: every file the body names is in the diff and nothing in the diff is unnamed; the message quoted in the body is byte-equal to :590; `Fixes #30418`, `Ruling-ref: 6657805240`, `Skills-docs:`, `Prior rulings read:`, the liveness answer, `Carried:` naming the `domain:ui` half and the six-line `## 维护者速读` are all present. Scope sits inside the order: the only file beyond the claim's named surface is `translation.zod.ts`, flagged in the report's `deviations` and in the body. 140 changed lines, no governed surface in the file list, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green. Required contexts `Build Core`, `Test Core` (8 shards), `Type Check` and `Lint` were still `in_progress` at review time.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` minor: a new authorable key on a settings-manifest shape (`Metadata-protocol: added`), refused only where it was never accepted before (no specifier parsed `confirmOffText` before this PR, as the strict-free `z.object` would have stripped it; the arm turns a silent strip into a named refusal on non-toggles, the Prime Directive #10 direction). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the right pair. `@objectstack/service-settings` patch is what the LEVEL axis owes; minor is tolerated by the gate but over-graded.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The arm's `spec.type !== 'toggle'` is broader than the `valueDomain` arm's `!SPECIFIERS_REQUIRING_KEY.has(spec.type)`, by design: the ruling's "any `type` other than `toggle`" means a `checkbox`-less, value-bearing `text` is refused too, and the pins cover it. No specifier type beside `toggle` has an off, so nothing is over-refused.
- The refusal is a parse-time door; the service registers manifests unparsed (:1233), so a misplaced key in a platform manifest is caught by that manifest's test, not at boot. Same standing as every other arm in this `superRefine`.
- The console still ignores the key (`SettingsField.tsx` :625 toggle arm untouched), and `useSettingsLabel` has no `fieldConfirmOff` probe; both are the carried `domain:ui` half. Until it lands the declaration is parsed, translated and not shown, which the body and changeset say in those words.
- The bundle is loaded raw at runtime (`settings-service-plugin.ts` :296-302); the strict leaf governs the contract and `tsc`, not a server's boot.

### ④ Design judgment

The fix is at the right layer and in the ruled shape: one optional key on `SpecifierSchema` named after the existing handler `confirmText`, one arm on the existing refinement beside the arm it mirrors, the translation leaf at the toggle's own address on the platform face only, and the manifest declaration with the ruled sentence carried in all four shipped locales and held there by the coverage test. Should-fix, in order: (1) regrade `@objectstack/service-settings` to `patch` in `.changeset/30418-settings-toggle-confirm-off.md` :3, the level a non-protocol change owes under the LEVEL axis and the #30202 precedent; (2) add `confirmOff: 'confirmOffText'` and `confirm: 'confirmOffText'` to the `keys` entry's `aliases` at `translation.zod.ts` :2315, mirroring `confirm: 'confirmText'` on the `actions` entry (:2331), so a borrowed spelling is named rather than sent round again; (3) soften the body's "without this leaf the bundle the service ships would be refused" to name the two doors that refuse it (`PlatformTranslationDataSchema` and `tsc` on the typed bundle), since the running service loads the bundle unparsed. None blocks landing; landing waits on the still-running required contexts going green.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 设置清单的开关（toggle）新增可选键 `confirmOffText`：开关要从开变成关之前，先弹出这句确认文字；不写就不确认。只有 toggle 能写，别的类型写了会被拒，报错里写明键和类型。认证设置里「邮箱和密码登录」开关声明了这句话：「用密码登录的人需要另一种登录方式」，中、日、西三语都有翻译。
- **为什么改：** 按你在 #30418 上裁的 A。之前 Setup 关掉邮箱密码登录时不会提醒。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯新增可选键，旧清单照常解析。控制台还没读这个键，所以落地后暂时不会弹窗，读者那一半在 #30500（domain:ui）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts`（`confirmOffText` 和 superRefine 新分支）；`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts`；`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` 的 `keys` 条目。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`，全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审 PASS，没有必须修的。五条裁决约束都核对过。开发者自报的偏差（translation.zod.ts 加一个叶子，让带这句翻译的语言包能通过解析）判定为必要，范围也对。采纳了两条建议：service-settings 的版本级别改成 patch，正文写明实际拒绝它的两道门。没采纳给新键加别名，因为新键没有旧拼写。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `1a29fff73ae896337bf1a00f98f8e33e4ca77685`

- **Shape:** 15 files (+141 −6) on merge-base `989ae42d`:
  - `SpecifierSchema.confirmOffText: I18nLabelSchema.optional()` with the ruled description; a `superRefine` arm beside the `valueDomain` arm refuses it on every non-toggle type, naming the key and the type;
  - `auth.manifest.ts` declares it on `email_password_enabled` with the #30299 sentence, translated at `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText` in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES;
  - the platform translation `keys` entry gains the `confirmOffText` leaf so that bundle parses;
